facts.text: The hotel sits on Jeddah's Corniche with views of the Red Sea and King Fahad Fountain.
facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Jeddah is a refined sanctuary on the Corniche, offering understated luxury with panoramic views of the Red Sea and King Fahad Fountain.

facts.text: The resort is set amid gardens.
facts.excerpt: Set amid lush gardens, the resort blends contemporary design with Arab-Andalusian elegance

facts.text: The hotel blends European architecture with Andalusian design by designers Gilles Quiffet and Patrice Hart.
facts.excerpt: The hotel seamlessly blends European architecture with Andalusian design, envisioned by designers Gilles Quiffet and Patrice Hart.

facts.text: The spa is split into Evania, a women's spa, and Seba, a men's spa.
facts.excerpt: **Evania Women Spa**

facts.text: Seba is the men's spa.
facts.excerpt: **Seba Men Spa**

facts.text: The spa has therapeutic aquamedic hydrotherapy pools.
facts.excerpt: Experience the transformative power of our exclusive therapeutic aquamedic pools, where water works to melt away muscle tension, stimulate circulation and alleviate stress.

facts.text: Nafoura serves contemporary Mediterranean cuisine from an open kitchen and charcoal grill, with an outdoor terrace overlooking the Red Sea and King Fahad's Fountain.
facts.excerpt: Delight in a selection of tantalizing mezzes and dishes prepared in our open kitchen and traditional charcoal grill, while enjoying the serene ambiance of our expansive outdoor terrace, which overlooks the breathtaking Red Sea

facts.text: Nafoura specializes in contemporary Mediterranean cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Nafoura Restaurant offers an exquisite all-day dining experience, specializing in contemporary Mediterranean cuisine crafted from the finest organic, seasonal ingredients.

facts.text: Nafoura hosts a Family Friday Brunch.
facts.excerpt: Family Friday Brunch

facts.text: Dardasha, the restaurant at the Evania ladies' spa, serves Middle Eastern and international dishes with indoor or alfresco seating.
facts.excerpt: With a refined à-la-carte menu showcasing both traditional Middle Eastern and international cuisine, guests can choose between elegant indoor seating or alfresco dining in a tranquil setting.

facts.text: The Lounge and Terrace serves light meals and signature beverages with views of the Red Sea and King Fahd Fountain.
facts.excerpt: The Lounge and Terrace is the hotel’s refined centerpiece, where modern elegance meets breathtaking views of the Red Sea and the iconic King Fahd Fountain.

facts.text: Andalusia restaurant is listed as temporarily closed.
facts.excerpt: Temporarily Closed

facts.text: Sea view rooms measure 40 square meters and suites range from 80 to 200 square meters.
facts.excerpt: Sea view rooms offer 40 square meters of refined comfort, while the suites range from 80 to 200 square meters

facts.text: The Royal Suite is a top-floor suite with French doors to a balcony overlooking the Red Sea and King Fahd fountain.
facts.excerpt: Elegant French doors lead to a balcony with unrestricted views of the Red Sea and famous King Fahd fountain.

facts.text: Terrace rooms have a private terrace with water views.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy 40 square meters of serene space with a private terrace offering breathtaking water views.

facts.text: Valet parking is complimentary.
facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Jeddah offers secure on-site parking facilities, 24 hours a day, conveniently situated near each building for easy access.

facts.text: King Abdulaziz International Airport is about 30 kilometers away; a taxi takes approximately 35 to 55 minutes.
facts.excerpt: Cost varies; journey takes approximately 35 to 55 minutes.

facts.text: The hotel is a short drive from historic Al-Balad, Red Sea Mall and King Fahad Fountain.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is ideally located overlooking the Red Sea, in the heart of the city, a short drive from the historic Al-Balad, Red Sea Mall and King Fahad Fountain.

facts.text: A solar power system in the car park charges the hotel's golf cart fleet.
facts.excerpt: The solar power system in the car park is designed to charge our golf cart fleet with renewable energy

facts.text: The fitness center overlooks the outdoor pool, spa and gardens and has Technogym equipment and personal trainers.
facts.excerpt: With expansive views of the outdoor pool, spa and gardens, the gym offers a bright, open space to elevate your workout, equipped with the latest cardio and strength-training Technogym equipment

facts.text: The hotel hosts weddings indoors or outdoors against a backdrop of the Red Sea and King Fahad Fountain.
facts.excerpt: Whether you envision an intimate indoor gathering or an enchanting outdoor celebration, we’ll curate a bespoke experience tailored to your every desire.

facts.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: our 24-hour In-Room Dining brings a curated selection of gourmet dishes directly to your room
